column1: # The usual GW2 words and their word in each language – translated by this table, both ways, like the official names
# (a word written in the sentence's language becomes the target's; a word asked about or quoted stays as written).
# Forms separated by "|": the first is the one written into a translation, the others are only recognized. An empty
# column takes the English word. Never invent: de/fr/es carry the game's own or the community's word; in languages the
# game is not in (it, pl, pt, ru, tr) the English word comes first – a local word only where players really write it
# (ru "рейд"); local forms after it are recognized ("rajdzie" is a raid) but never written. Add only what
# translation_bench shows a translator gets wrong; an empty column is better than a wrong word.
